documents.title: NAVER GAK Chuncheon opening press release

excerpts.text: GAK Chuncheon is described as NAVER's data center in Chuncheon.
Maximum power 40,000kW; dual power and Dynamic UPS/STS are described.

documents.title: NAVER GAK Sejong opening press release

excerpts.text: GAK Sejong is presented as a newly opened NAVER data center.
NAVER's GAK portfolio includes Chuncheon and Sejong facilities.
The facility page describes 154kV, dual feeds, up to 270MW, UPS, and generators.
NAVER describes GAK Sejong expansion milestones of 55MW, 100MW, and 200MW through 2028.

documents.title: NAVER GAK Sejong 200MW AI Factory announcement

excerpts.text: NAVER describes a 200MW NVIDIA DSX AI Factory at GAK Sejong as entering execution.
Kakao describes opening the Ansan data center and resilient infrastructure.

documents.title: LG U+ Pyeongchon 2 data center completion

excerpts.text: LG U+ describes completion of Pyeongchon 2 data center.

documents.title: LG U+ Paju AI data center construction update

excerpts.text: The Paju AI data center is described as a construction project.

documents.title: LG U+ Paju AI data center progress update

excerpts.text: LG U+ reports Paju AI data center construction with a 2027 target.
kt cloud describes opening the Gasan AI data center.
The presentation references Gasan AIDC within KT's data-center business.

documents.title: Samsung SDS Dongtan data center media day

excerpts.text: Samsung SDS presents the Dongtan data center as operating cloud infrastructure.

documents.title: National AI Data Center in Gwangju service launch

excerpts.text: NHN reports the Gwangju National AI Data Center service launch.

documents.title: Equinix and GIC Seoul xScale investment

excerpts.text: Equinix and GIC announce investment in Seoul xScale data centers.
Equinix publishes current technical specifications for the Seoul SL2x facility.
Digital Realty announces colocation infrastructure availability at ICN10.
Digital Realty lists ICN10 as a Seoul data-center facility.

documents.title: Empyrion Digital KR1 Gangnam grand opening

excerpts.text: Empyrion Digital reports the grand opening of KR1 Gangnam.
STT GDC reports opening STT Seoul 1 in South Korea.
STT-Seoul-1: IT-load=30MW; utility=dual-22.9kV; UPS=distributed-redundant; generator-runtime=24h.

documents.title: Ulsan AI data center investment announcement

excerpts.text: Ulsan announces an AI data-center investment involving SK and AWS.

documents.title: SK Telecom Ulsan AI data center construction update

excerpts.text: SK Telecom says Ulsan AI data-center construction is underway with AWS and targets operation in the second half of 2027.

documents.title: SK Telecom Ulsan AI data center integrated MEP purchase contract

excerpts.text: SK Telecom identifies Schneider Electric as integrated MEP supplier for switchgear, UPS, transformers, automation, and another equipment area at Ulsan.
Digital Edge announces availability of the 36MW SEL2 data center.
Digital Edge lists SEL2 as its Incheon data-center facility.
SEL2: capacity=36MW; utility=2x154kV; UPS=N+1-SUPS; generator=N+1-catcher; fuel=24h; design-PUE=1.28.

documents.title: Digital Edge SEL5 power secured announcement

excerpts.text: Digital Edge announces secured power for a planned 60MW Ansan data center.

documents.title: NXPLUS C 24 medium-voltage switchgear technical data

excerpts.text: 7.2/12/15/17.5/24kV; 50/60Hz; busbar≤2500A; feeder≤2000A; short-time=20/25kA@3s; IP65; IAC=A-FLR-25kA@1s; ambient=-5…55°C.
At-24kV: power-frequency-withstand=50kV; lightning-impulse-withstand=125kV; rated-peak-withstand=54/68kA.

documents.title: Medium and low voltage switchgear product page

excerpts.text: HRS-LLF: IEC62271-200; 12/24kV; 630A; breaking-capacity=21kA@3s.
UniGear-ZS3.2: rated-voltage≤24kV; main-busbar≤4000A; short-time-current≤63kA; duration not stated in candidate excerpt.
Order-4GX6364-3EY: 2000kVA; 20/0.4kV; impedance=6%; no-load-loss=2340W; load-loss@120°C=16000W.
GEAFOL-Neo: IEC60076-11; classes=C3/E3/F1; power≤6.3MVA; MV≤40.5kV; other-classes-on-request.
Distribution-transformer family: 100–20,000kVA; rated-voltage=220–36,000V.
RESIBLOC-family: high-voltage≤36kV; partial-discharge<10pC; model and test conditions require review.
IEC 62271-200:2011 is Edition 2.0, published 2011-10-24 and withdrawn 2021-05-27.
IEC states that the third edition cancels and replaces the second edition published in 2011 and constitutes a technical revision.
